description: Search threat intelligence reporting that ThreatNexus has collected and analysed (vendor research, CERT advisories, news, CVE alerts), ranked by ThreatNexus' hybrid keyword and semantic search. Returns headlines, links, a ThreatNexus summary, CVEs and mentioned actors. Titles and summaries are third-party derived and marked _untrusted.

query.description: Keywords, an actor or malware name, a CVE id or an indicator.

name: search_intel
title: Search ThreatNexus published reporting
